CREATE PROC [BNKM].[SP_CUSTOMERACCOUNTLIMIT_CCD_v2] AS
BEGIN

WITH TEMP_BNKM_CUSTOMERACCOUNTLIMIT_UNION AS (
SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY CRDACCT_NBR, BNK_CODE, SOURCE_CODE ORDER BY CRDACCT_DELTA_DATE DESC, Monthly_Daily ) RN, * FROM (
SELECT 
CRDACCT_DELTA_DATE
,BCC.CRDACCT_NBR
,CRDACCT_DTE_CURR_CREDIT_LIMIT
,CRDACCT_DTE_OPEN
,CRDACCT_DTE_LST_CREDIT_LIMIT
,CRDACCT_CRLIMIT
,CRDACCT_TEMP_CRLIMIT
,CRDACCT_PERM_CRLIMIT
,CRDACCT_LST_CRLIMIT
,CRDACCT_CASHLIMIT
,CRDACCT_INSTL_LMT
,CRDACCT_DTE_TEMP_CRLIMIT_EXP
,BNK_CODE
,SOURCE_CODE
,1 Monthly_Daily
FROM  BUSC.CCD_CBCEXCACFP BCC
WHERE BCC.isLatest = '1'

UNION

SELECT 
CRDACCT_DELTA_DATE
,BCC.CRDACCT_NBR
,CRDACCT_DTE_CURR_CREDIT_LIMIT
,CRDACCT_DTE_OPEN
,CRDACCT_DTE_LST_CREDIT_LIMIT
,CRDACCT_CRLIMIT
,CRDACCT_TEMP_CRLIMIT
,CRDACCT_PERM_CRLIMIT
,CRDACCT_LST_CRLIMIT
,CRDACCT_CASHLIMIT
,CRDACCT_INSTL_LMT
,CRDACCT_DTE_TEMP_CRLIMIT_EXP
,BNK_CODE
,SOURCE_CODE
,2 Monthly_Daily
FROM  BUSC.CCD_CBCEXCACCP BCC
WHERE BCC.isLatest = '1'
)A
)


SELECT *INTO #TEMP_BNKM_CUSTOMERACCOUNTLIMIT_UNION FROM TEMP_BNKM_CUSTOMERACCOUNTLIMIT_UNION WHERE RN = 1;


WITH TEMP_BNKM_CUSTOMERACCOUNTLIMIT AS(
	SELECT
        BCC.CRDACCT_DELTA_DATE
		,BCC.CRDACCT_NBR AS CustomerAccountId
        ,'PHP' AS IsoCurrencyCode
		,'Credit Limit' AS LimitTypeId
		,CASE
			WHEN BCC.CRDACCT_DTE_CURR_CREDIT_LIMIT = 0 THEN CONVERT(datetime2, CONVERT(varchar, BCC.CRDACCT_DTE_OPEN))
            ELSE CONVERT(datetime2, CONVERT(varchar, BCC.CRDACCT_DTE_CURR_CREDIT_LIMIT ))
        END AS Timestamp
		,BCC.CRDACCT_CRLIMIT AS LimitAmount
		,CASE
            WHEN BCC.CRDACCT_DTE_TEMP_CRLIMIT_EXP = 0 THEN '1900-01-01' 
            ELSE CONVERT(datetime, CONVERT(varchar, BCC.CRDACCT_DTE_TEMP_CRLIMIT_EXP))
        END AS LimitEndTimestamp
		,BCC.BNK_CODE AS FinancialInstitutionId
		,BCC.SOURCE_CODE AS SourceSystemCode
		,0 AS TaskRunId
		,0 AS WorkFlowId
		,getdate() AS InsertDttm
	FROM  #TEMP_BNKM_CUSTOMERACCOUNTLIMIT_UNION BCC
	
	UNION

--Temporary Credit Limit -- CRDACCT_DTE_CURR_CREDIT_LIMIT -- CRDACCT_TEMP_CRLIMIT
    SELECT
        BCC.CRDACCT_DELTA_DATE
		,BCC.CRDACCT_NBR AS CustomerAccountId
        ,'PHP' AS IsoCurrencyCode
		,'Temporary Credit Limit' AS LimitTypeId
		,CASE
			WHEN BCC.CRDACCT_DTE_CURR_CREDIT_LIMIT = 0 THEN CONVERT(datetime2, CONVERT(varchar, BCC.CRDACCT_DTE_OPEN))
            ELSE CONVERT(datetime2, CONVERT(varchar, BCC.CRDACCT_DTE_CURR_CREDIT_LIMIT ))
        END AS Timestamp
		,BCC.CRDACCT_DTE_CURR_CREDIT_LIMIT AS LimitAmount
		,CASE
            WHEN BCC.CRDACCT_DTE_TEMP_CRLIMIT_EXP = 0 THEN '1900-01-01' 
            ELSE CONVERT(datetime, CONVERT(varchar, BCC.CRDACCT_DTE_TEMP_CRLIMIT_EXP))
        END AS LimitEndTimestamp
		,BCC.BNK_CODE AS FinancialInstitutionId
		,BCC.SOURCE_CODE AS SourceSystemCode
		,0 AS TaskRunId
		,0 AS WorkFlowId
		,getdate() AS InsertDttm
	FROM  #TEMP_BNKM_CUSTOMERACCOUNTLIMIT_UNION BCC
	
	UNION
	
	-- Permanent Credit Limit -- CRDACCT_DTE_CURR_CREDIT_LIMIT -- CRDACCT_PERM_CRLIMIT 
	SELECT
        BCC.CRDACCT_DELTA_DATE
		,BCC.CRDACCT_NBR AS CustomerAccountId
        ,'PHP' AS IsoCurrencyCode
		,'Permanent Credit Limit' AS LimitTypeId
		,CASE
			WHEN BCC.CRDACCT_DTE_CURR_CREDIT_LIMIT = 0 THEN CONVERT(datetime2, CONVERT(varchar, BCC.CRDACCT_DTE_OPEN))
            ELSE CONVERT(datetime2, CONVERT(varchar, BCC.CRDACCT_DTE_CURR_CREDIT_LIMIT ))
        END AS Timestamp
		,BCC.CRDACCT_PERM_CRLIMIT AS LimitAmount
		,CASE
            WHEN BCC.CRDACCT_DTE_TEMP_CRLIMIT_EXP = 0 THEN '1900-01-01' 
            ELSE CONVERT(datetime, CONVERT(varchar, BCC.CRDACCT_DTE_TEMP_CRLIMIT_EXP))
        END AS LimitEndTimestamp
		,BCC.BNK_CODE AS FinancialInstitutionId
		,BCC.SOURCE_CODE AS SourceSystemCode
		,0 AS TaskRunId
		,0 AS WorkFlowId
		,getdate() AS InsertDttm
	FROM  #TEMP_BNKM_CUSTOMERACCOUNTLIMIT_UNION BCC
	
	UNION
	
	-- Last Credit Limit -- CRDACCT_DTE_LST_CREDIT_LIMIT -- CRDACCT_LST_CRLIMIT 
	SELECT
        BCC.CRDACCT_DELTA_DATE
		,BCC.CRDACCT_NBR AS CustomerAccountId
        ,'PHP' AS IsoCurrencyCode
		,'Last Credit Limit' AS LimitTypeId
		,CASE
			WHEN BCC.CRDACCT_DTE_LST_CREDIT_LIMIT = 0 THEN CONVERT(datetime2, CONVERT(varchar, BCC.CRDACCT_DTE_OPEN )) 
            ELSE CONVERT(datetime2, CONVERT(varchar,BCC.CRDACCT_DTE_LST_CREDIT_LIMIT)) 
        END AS Timestamp
		,BCC.CRDACCT_LST_CRLIMIT AS LimitAmount
		,CASE
            WHEN BCC.CRDACCT_DTE_TEMP_CRLIMIT_EXP = 0 THEN '1900-01-01' 
            ELSE CONVERT(datetime, CONVERT(varchar, BCC.CRDACCT_DTE_TEMP_CRLIMIT_EXP))
        END AS LimitEndTimestamp
		,BCC.BNK_CODE AS FinancialInstitutionId
		,BCC.SOURCE_CODE AS SourceSystemCode
		,0 AS TaskRunId
		,0 AS WorkFlowId
		,getdate() AS InsertDttm
	FROM  #TEMP_BNKM_CUSTOMERACCOUNTLIMIT_UNION BCC
	
	UNION
	
	-- Cash Credit Limit -- CRDACCT_DELTA_DATE -- CRDACCT_CASHLIMIT 
	SELECT
        BCC.CRDACCT_DELTA_DATE
		,BCC.CRDACCT_NBR AS CustomerAccountId
        ,'PHP' AS IsoCurrencyCode
		,'Cash Credit Limit' AS LimitTypeId
		,CASE
			WHEN BCC.CRDACCT_DELTA_DATE = 0 THEN CONVERT(datetime2, CONVERT(varchar, BCC.CRDACCT_DTE_OPEN))
            ELSE CONVERT(datetime2, CONVERT(varchar, BCC.CRDACCT_DELTA_DATE)) 
        END AS Timestamp
		,BCC.CRDACCT_CASHLIMIT AS LimitAmount
		,CASE
            WHEN BCC.CRDACCT_DTE_TEMP_CRLIMIT_EXP = 0 THEN '1900-01-01' 
            ELSE CONVERT(datetime, CONVERT(varchar, BCC.CRDACCT_DTE_TEMP_CRLIMIT_EXP))
        END AS LimitEndTimestamp
		,BCC.BNK_CODE AS FinancialInstitutionId
		,BCC.SOURCE_CODE AS SourceSystemCode
		,0 AS TaskRunId
		,0 AS WorkFlowId
		,getdate() AS InsertDttm
	FROM  #TEMP_BNKM_CUSTOMERACCOUNTLIMIT_UNION BCC
	
	UNION
	
	-- Installment Limit -- CRDACCT_DELTA_DATE -- CRDACCT_INSTL_LMT 
	SELECT
        BCC.CRDACCT_DELTA_DATE
		,BCC.CRDACCT_NBR AS CustomerAccountId
        ,'PHP' AS IsoCurrencyCode
		,'Installment Limit' AS LimitTypeId
		,CASE
			WHEN BCC.CRDACCT_DELTA_DATE = 0 THEN CONVERT(datetime2, CONVERT(varchar, BCC.CRDACCT_DTE_OPEN))
            ELSE CONVERT(datetime2, CONVERT(varchar, BCC.CRDACCT_DELTA_DATE)) 
        END AS Timestamp
		,BCC.CRDACCT_INSTL_LMT AS LimitAmount
		,CASE
            WHEN BCC.CRDACCT_DTE_TEMP_CRLIMIT_EXP = 0 THEN '1900-01-01' 
            ELSE CONVERT(datetime, CONVERT(varchar, BCC.CRDACCT_DTE_TEMP_CRLIMIT_EXP))
        END AS LimitEndTimestamp
		,BCC.BNK_CODE AS FinancialInstitutionId
		,BCC.SOURCE_CODE AS SourceSystemCode
		,0 AS TaskRunId
		,0 AS WorkFlowId
		,getdate() AS InsertDttm
	FROM  #TEMP_BNKM_CUSTOMERACCOUNTLIMIT_UNION BCC
)

SELECT *INTO #TEMP_BNKM_CUSTOMERACCOUNTLIMIT FROM TEMP_BNKM_CUSTOMERACCOUNTLIMIT;

WITH TEMP_BNKM_CUSTOMERACCOUNTLIMIT_SRC AS(
SELECT 
HASHBYTES('MD5', CONCAT(
CONVERT(nvarchar, CustomerAccountId)
,CONVERT(datetime2, Timestamp)
,CONVERT(varchar, LimitTypeId)
,CONVERT(nvarchar, FinancialInstitutionId)
,CONVERT(varchar, SourceSystemCode)
))HASHROW
,CustomerAccountId
,Timestamp
,LimitTypeId
,FinancialInstitutionId
,SourceSystemCode
FROM #TEMP_BNKM_CUSTOMERACCOUNTLIMIT
)
,
TEMP_BNKM_CUSTOMERACCOUNTLIMIT_TGT 
AS(
SELECT 
HASHBYTES('MD5', CONCAT(
CONVERT(nvarchar, CustomerAccountId)
,CONVERT(datetime2, Timestamp)
,CONVERT(varchar, LimitTypeId)
,CONVERT(nvarchar, FinancialInstitutionId)
,CONVERT(varchar, SourceSystemCode)
))HASHROW
,CustomerAccountId
,Timestamp
,LimitTypeId
,FinancialInstitutionId
,SourceSystemCode
FROM BNKM.CustomerAccountLimit_v2
)
,
TEMP_BNKM_CUSTOMERACCOUNTLIMIT_DELTA AS (
    SELECT	
		SRC.HASHROW AS SRC_HR
		,TGT.HASHROW AS TGT_HR
	,ISNULL(SRC.CustomerAccountId,TGT.CustomerAccountId) AS CustomerAccountId
    ,ISNULL(SRC.Timestamp,TGT.Timestamp) AS Timestamp
	,ISNULL(SRC.LimitTypeId,TGT.LimitTypeId) AS LimitTypeId		
	,ISNULL(SRC.FinancialInstitutionId,TGT.FinancialInstitutionId) AS FinancialInstitutionId	
	,ISNULL(SRC.SourceSystemCode,TGT.SourceSystemCode) AS SourceSystemCode	
    ,CASE
        WHEN TGT.HASHROW IS NULL THEN 'INSERT' 
	    WHEN SRC.HASHROW <> TGT.HASHROW THEN 'INSERT'
	ELSE NULL END AS RECORD_STATUS


FROM TEMP_BNKM_CUSTOMERACCOUNTLIMIT_SRC	SRC
LEFT JOIN TEMP_BNKM_CUSTOMERACCOUNTLIMIT_TGT	TGT
ON	SRC.CustomerAccountId = TGT.CustomerAccountId
AND SRC.Timestamp = TGT.Timestamp
AND SRC.LimitTypeId = TGT.LimitTypeId
AND SRC.FinancialInstitutionId = TGT.FinancialInstitutionId
AND SRC.SourceSystemCode = TGT.SourceSystemCode
WHERE SRC.HASHROW <> TGT.HASHROW OR TGT.HASHROW IS NULL
)

SELECT * INTO #TEMP_BNKM_CUSTOMERACCOUNTLIMIT_DELTA FROM TEMP_BNKM_CUSTOMERACCOUNTLIMIT_DELTA;

INSERT INTO BNKM.CustomerAccountLimit_v2(
CustomerAccountId
,IsoCurrencyCode
,LimitTypeId
,Timestamp
,LimitAmount
,LimitEndTimestamp
,FinancialInstitutionId
,SourceSystemCode
,TaskRunId
,WorkFlowId
,InsertDttm 
)
SELECT DISTINCT
SRC.CustomerAccountId
,IsoCurrencyCode
,SRC.LimitTypeId
,SRC.Timestamp
,LimitAmount
,LimitEndTimestamp
,SRC.FinancialInstitutionId
,SRC.SourceSystemCode
,TaskRunId
,WorkFlowId
,InsertDttm
FROM #TEMP_BNKM_CUSTOMERACCOUNTLIMIT SRC
JOIN #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountLimit_DELTA DELTA 
ON DELTA.CustomerAccountId = SRC.CustomerAccountId 
AND DELTA.LimitTypeId = SRC.LimitTypeId  
AND DELTA.Timestamp = SRC.Timestamp
AND DELTA.FinancialInstitutionId = SRC.FinancialInstitutionId
AND DELTA.SourceSystemCode = SRC.SourceSystemCode
WHERE RECORD_STATUS in ('INSERT');

DROP TABLE #TEMP_BNKM_CUSTOMERACCOUNTLIMIT_UNION;
DROP TABLE #TEMP_BNKM_CUSTOMERACCOUNTLIMIT;
DROP TABLE #TEMP_BNKM_CUSTOMERACCOUNTLIMIT_DELTA;

END
GO
